entries.title: Matthew 1:1
segments: ¶Book of the generation of Jesus Christ, Son of David, Son of Abraham.

entries.title: Matthew 1:2
segments: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob begat Juda and his brethren;

entries.title: Matthew 1:3
segments: and Juda begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom, and Esrom begat Aram,

entries.title: Matthew 1:4
segments: and Aram begat Aminadab, and Aminadab begat Naasson, and Naasson begat Salmon,

entries.title: Matthew 1:5
segments: and Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse,

entries.title: Matthew 1:6
segments: and Jesse begat David the king. And David begat Solomon, of her [that had been the wife] of Urias;

entries.title: Matthew 1:7
segments: and Solomon begat Roboam, and Roboam begat Abia, and Abia begat Asa,

entries.title: Matthew 1:8
segments: and Asa begat Josaphat, and Josaphat begat Joram, and Joram begat Ozias,

entries.title: Matthew 1:9
segments: and Ozias begat Joatham, and Joatham begat Achaz, and Achaz begat Ezekias,

entries.title: Matthew 1:10
segments: and Ezekias begat Manasses, and Manasses begat Amon, and Amon begat Josias,

entries.title: Matthew 1:11
segments: and Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away of Babylon.

entries.title: Matthew 1:12
segments: And after the carrying away of Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel, and Salathiel begat Zorobabel,

entries.title: Matthew 1:13
segments: and Zorobabel begat Abiud, and Abiud begat Eliakim, and Eliakim begat Azor,

entries.title: Matthew 1:14
segments: and Azor begat Sadoc, and Sadoc begat Achim, and Achim begat Eliud,

entries.title: Matthew 1:15
segments: and Eliud begat Eliazar, and Eliazar begat Matthan, and Matthan begat Jacob,

entries.title: Matthew 1:16
segments: and Jacob begat Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

entries.title: Matthew 1:17
segments: All the generations, therefore, from Abraham to David [were] fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away of Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the carrying away of Babylon unto the Christ, fourteen generations.

entries.title: Matthew 1:18
segments: ¶Now the birth of Jesus Christ was thus: His mother, Mary, that is, having been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together, she was found to be with child of [the] Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:19
segments: But Joseph, her husband, being [a] righteous [man], and unwilling to expose her publicly, purposed to have put her away secretly;

entries.title: Matthew 1:20
segments: but while he pondered on these things, behold, an angel of [the] Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, fear not to take to [thee] Mary, thy wife, for that which is begotten in her is of [the] Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:21
segments: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Jesus, for *he* shall save his people from their sins.

entries.title: Matthew 1:22
segments: Now all this came to pass that that might be fulfilled which was spoken by [the] Lord, through the prophet, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 1:23
segments: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which is, being interpreted, 'God with us.'

entries.title: Matthew 1:24
segments: But Joseph, having awoke up from his sleep, did as the angel of [the] Lord had enjoined him, and took to [him] his wife,

entries.title: Matthew 1:25
segments: and knew her not until she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name Jesus.
